title: The $3,400 Medicare Trap Hiding in Your Retirement Income
hook: Earning just $1 too much in retirement triggers a Medicare surcharge most people never see coming — and it can cost you $3,400 more every single year.
angle: IRMAA (Income-Related Monthly Adjustment Amount) silently penalizes retirees who cross an income threshold — even by accident through a Roth conversion, home sale, or Required Minimum Distribution. The IRS uses income from two years prior, so by the time the bill arrives it's too late to reverse.
audience: Pre-retirees and recent retirees aged 55–70 with employer retirement accounts or investment income
key_numbers: $3,400+ annual surcharge for crossing the first IRMAA bracket
